verdict.rationale: Gusto documents in-product AI that works on the customer's own data. Intelligent payroll automations flag anomalies and anything unusual for review, an agent prepares payroll and sends a prioritized list of decisions, and Gus, the AI Benefits Assistant, gives personalized real-time guidance. Open-ended questions about payroll and team data are documented only through external AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT), not inside the product, and all evidence comes from vendor press releases. Missing for 10: a native in-product conversational way to query your own data, AI insights beyond payroll anomalies and benefits (e.g., labor-cost or financial insights), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
